subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Which cron history product surface should core support beyond the existing SQLite `cron.runs` path, and what redaction/access/retention rules must apply before adding CLI export, follow, time-range, and summary behavior?
rationale: The remaining request changes public CLI/protocol/config behavior and can expose sensitive operational history, so automation should not choose the durable history contract or security policy alone.

options.title: Narrow `cron.runs` expansion
options.body: Add timestamp filters and a focused CLI/docs surface on the existing SQLite reader, then defer or separately decide export, follow, aggregates, and manual prune behavior.

options.title: Full audit-history suite
options.body: Implement the broader logs/history CLI, export/follow, success-rate summaries, and retention/prune commands together after a larger security and UX design pass.

options.title: Retain current scope
options.body: Document the existing `cron.runs` and `cron.runLog.keepLines` behavior as the supported surface and close or narrow the remaining feature request.

recommendation.title: Narrow `cron.runs` expansion
recommendation.body: Add timestamp filters and a focused CLI/docs surface on the existing SQLite reader, then defer or separately decide export, follow, aggregates, and manual prune behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined history signal for cron run history and prior review context on this exact issue.
